description: FAST vanilla-transformer comparison baseline. Byte-for-byte clone of exp002_untied_vanilla_baseline_nebius (pure MinimalGPT + RoPE, untied head, standard dense GELU FFN 384->1536->384 -- NO LUT / hyperplane modules anywhere; train.py copied verbatim, it is fully config-driven) with three deliberate changes for a short, low-wait run: (b) batch size 64 sequences/step -> device_batch_size 64 & total_batch_size 32768 (=64*512), grad_accum=1 (exp002 was 48 seq / 24576 tokens); (c) n_steps 16000 -> 4096; (d) eval cadence shortened proportionally 200 -> 50 (200 * 4096/16000 = 51.2), keeping ~82 eval points like exp002's ~80. Everything else identical to exp002: d_model 384, 6 layers, 6 heads, seq 512, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, warmup 0.1, seed 1, bf16, vocab 32768, same base_data_climbmix subset + tokenizer. Purpose: a quick (~a few minutes on H100) dense-FFN anchor to A/B future LUT/hyperplane experiments against without the ~0.5h full-baseline wait. NOT the reproducibility anchor -- exp002 (1.20144 bpb, 16k steps) remains the on-box reference number; this short run will land HIGHER (fewer steps) and is only a fast relative yardstick.
